# Suppliers

## When to use this page

Use this screen to review its available records and supported actions.

## Typical tasks

- Follow the documented “Operator steps and checks” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “Screen references” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “List” instructions below.

> Ownership: Purchasing records commercial supplier commitments; Inventory posts physical quantities; Accounting and Payments manage AP and settlement.

## Operator steps and checks

Use the Supplier list to locate a supplier by name or code and inspect activity, status and contact details. Open the supplier record before adding procurement commitments; confirm that it is active and that its confirmation preference/default terms match the intended workflow. Supplier preferences influence the PO but do not replace a PO line's supplier-product reference.

Review linked Purchase Orders, confirmations and supplier-specific product catalog references before editing or deactivating a supplier. Changes to supplier master data do not rewrite posted bills, payments or historical stock movements.
